summary: V3.2 review — Game-system selector (11 systems) + comprehensive BESM blurb expansion. Added 17 new pytest cases (TestIter8GameSystems[4], TestIter8BesmBlurbCoverage[6], TestIter8CampaignSystemId[6], TestIter8PermissionsPolicyHeader[1]) — all 17 PASS. Updated 2 stale iter-7 tests (test_enhancement_blurb_shared, test_limiter_blurb_shared) that became wrong by design under V3.2 (per-name blurbs now, not shared); renamed to *_per_name and they pass. Full backend run: 123/125 stable (98.4%); 2 failures are pre-existing carry-overs from iter_3+ (CORS preflight wildcard short-circuit when FRONTEND_URL empty; LLM 429 cooldown on TestRecap::test_recap_bullet_style). The 1 transient WS flake (test_webrtc_answer_and_ice_targeted) PASSES on isolated rerun — not a regression. Frontend Playwright: (a) /app/campaigns?create=1 modal renders [data-testid='create-system'] with EXACTLY 11 options, first='✓ BESM 4E — Dyskami Publishing', all others prefixed '○ '. (b) Selecting dnd-5e updates [data-testid='system-blurb'] to D&D copy + scaffold disclaimer. (c) Creating a dnd-5e campaign succeeds and lands GM in Atelier (/genesis); the campaign DETAIL page shows tri-stat-credit with 'Wizards of the Coast' + 'Mechanics for this system are scaffolded; reference content coming soon. Bring your physical book to the table.' (d) BESM-system campaign detail still renders 'Tri-Stat Emporium / Dyskami' credit (regression intact). (e) /app/reference shows ref-system-note paragraph naming all 10 scaffolded systems; Defects tab = 36 ref-blurb-defects-* cards, Limiters tab = 23 cards with 23/23 unique blurb texts (Activation ≠ Charges confirmed), Enhancements tab = 5 cards with 5 distinct blurbs (Area/Duration/Range/Targets/Potent each unique). (f) Player @ /app/campaigns: new-campaign-btn HTML-disabled with text 'GMs only' (V3.1 P0 regression intact). All UI green; no console errors in the V3.2 surfaces.

minor.issue: (carry-over from iter_3+) FRONTEND_URL empty in env → CORSMiddleware allow_origins=['*'] short-circuits regex matcher; preflight reflects '*' instead of caller origin. Fix: pass allow_origins=[] when wildcard semantics desired so allow_origin_regex applies.
(carry-over) Returns 429 'Recap cooldown' under repeat runs; not a code bug but the test should mock LLM or apply a longer pre-test sleep.
Flaky in full-suite run under cluster load; PASSES on isolated rerun. Same flake noted in iter_7.

action_items: (Optional, carry-over) Fix CORS wildcard short-circuit by using allow_origins=[] when FRONTEND_URL is empty so allow_origin_regex applies.
(Optional, carry-over) Add per-(session,user) cooldown bypass or LLM mock for recap tests so 429s don't bubble up.
(Optional) Cache /api/besm/reference (functools.lru_cache) — payload is fully static and now serialises 86+36+5+23+21+power_levels+generic_blurbs on every call. Hot endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1575 lines (up from 1543 in iter_7) — the system_id validation block (~lines 720-770) is duplicated between create_campaign and update_campaign. Extract a helper `_resolve_system(data) -> (sid, system_name)` that raises HTTPException(400) on unknown id; reduces drift risk.
GAME_SYSTEMS list is iterated via `next((s for s in GAME_SYSTEMS if s['id']==sid), None)` on every campaign POST/PUT. Build a module-level dict GAME_SYSTEMS_BY_ID at import time for O(1) lookup.

/api/systems is public (no auth) which is correct, but it does not set Cache-Control. Add `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300` since the payload is fully static — saves bandwidth on the CreateModal mount.

system_id default ('besm-4e') is hardcoded in CampaignIn (line 189) AND referenced as DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID elsewhere — risk of drift. Use `system_id: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_ID)` so a future rename of the default flows automatically.

Frontend CreateModal: the '✓' / '○' prefixes render inside <option> text which won't show in some browsers' native select styling on macOS/iOS. Consider grouping with <optgroup label='Supported'> and <optgroup label='Coming soon'> for semantic clarity (still functional today, just brittle).
SystemCredit subcomponent fetches /api/systems on every CampaignDetail mount; cache the result in a module-level promise or a React context so it's loaded once per session.
